children: AMR Resources Acquisition announced holders may separately trade Class A ordinary shares and warrants starting Sept. 8, 2026.
Units may be separated beginning Sept. 8, 2026, allowing separate trading of Ordinary Shares and Warrants.
Each Unit equals one Class A ordinary share and one-half of a redeemable warrant; only whole warrants will trade.
Whole warrants entitle holders to buy one Class A ordinary share at $11.50 per share; only whole warrants are exercisable.
Separated Ordinary Shares and Warrants will trade on Nasdaq under symbols AMAC and AMACW; unsplit Units remain AMACU.
Holders must have brokers contact Continental Stock Transfer & Trust Company to effect separation of Units.
